input.brief: Private coach-led training room in East Austin, capped at thirty members, training muscle, mindset and mission; navy walls, gold racks, arched mirrors

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Swatch column beside the view
hero.blueprint: A 10px frame of paper colour surrounds the screen. Columns 1–10 are one photograph panel, full height inside the frame, corners radiused 12px, `object-fit: cover`: a wide, calm view with a low horizon and a great deal of sky. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third on two lines of light-weight serif at clamp(72px, 8.6vw, 132px), white, with a neutral scrim behind that band only if the sky is pale. The wordmark sits top-left inside the panel, 28px in. The single action, a white rectangular button, sits bottom-centre, 36px above the panel's lower edge; one supporting sentence at 18px sits bottom-left on columns 1–4, level with it. Columns 11–12 are both the navigation and a preview of the page: a full-height stack of five flat colour blocks of equal height, butted together with no gaps, each holding one text link at 16px in its top-left corner with 20px padding. The five colours are sampled from the photograph, ordered light to dark, and each is the ground colour of the section its link scrolls to. There is no other navigation.
hero.mobile: The photograph panel takes the top 64svh inside an 8px frame, with the headline at 12vw on two lines in its upper third and the action button at its bottom-centre. The swatch column becomes five full-width bars, each 52px tall with its link at 15px, stacked directly under the panel; the first three show above the fold. The supporting sentence moves into the first section.
hero.headline: A two-line statement of three to five words, up to about 14 characters per line at 8.6vw, set over the sky.

motion.name: Colour by chapter
motion.description: Each chapter is its own full-bleed field of one palette colour, so the ground changes exactly at section edges as you scroll, never as a global recolouring of the screen. The only movement: the fixed header (or the one pinned element) takes the ink of the chapter beneath it, switching with a 300ms colour transition as each edge passes under it. Do not drive the page background from an observer: in blind tests a page recoloured mid-section, with a paragraph sitting on two colours, read as broken twice.

sections.name: Statement tiles
sections.blueprint: A board of filled tiles with 8px gaps and 8px outer margins: 12 columns by two rows of 38svh each. Tile A, columns 1–8 across both rows, is the darkest tile and carries a slogan of two to four words in capitals at clamp(64px, 9vw, 132px), leading 0.86, on two lines, set hard against the tile's 20px left padding and bottom-aligned. Tile B, columns 9–12 of row one, is a pale tile with one word or figure at the same size, bottom-aligned, cropped by `overflow: hidden` if it runs long. Tile C, columns 9–12 of row two, is a photograph covering the tile. Below the board a fourth tile spans all 12 columns in the page ground colour: its left half is empty and a text of 90–130 words at 22–24px with leading 1.35 runs in columns 7–12 with 40px padding. No separate heading: the slogan in tile A is the heading.
sections.mobile: A two-column board with 6px gaps. The slogan tile spans both columns at 46svh with type at 17vw on two lines; the word tile and the photograph tile sit side by side as squares; the long text tile spans both columns with 20px padding at 18px.

sections.name: Stacking colour sheets
sections.blueprint: Three to five capabilities, each a full-width flat colour sheet about 86svh tall with only its top corners rounded at 28px. Every sheet is position: sticky, with top offsets rising by 72px from one sheet to the next, so each new sheet slides up over the last and leaves the previous sheet's title band showing, like tabbed folders in a drawer. Inside a sheet: the capability name top-left at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px), sitting within that 72px band; a paragraph of up to 40ch at 18px bottom-left; and in columns 7–12 one photograph filling the sheet from below the band to the bottom edge, square corners, no inset. Sheet colours follow the palette in a fixed order, with ink chosen per sheet. The heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px), sits on the ground above the stack with 48px beneath and scrolls away normally.
sections.mobile: Sheets stay sticky but the offset shrinks to 52px and the name drops to 22px so it fits the visible band. Inside each sheet the photograph comes first at 4:3 and full width, then the paragraph at 17px with 20px padding. Sheets are as tall as their content, 70svh at least.

sections.name: Two-column menu, photo bullets
sections.blueprint: A menu or catalogue list in which each item has a small cut-out photograph where a bullet would be. Each category opens with its name at clamp(32px, 3.4vw, 50px) at the left margin and the number of items at 16px right-aligned on the same baseline, with 96px above and 40px below. Items then run in two columns with a 64px gutter and 36px between rows. Each item is a two-part row: a 64px photograph of the item on a plain background at the left (multiplied onto the ground with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, or masked to the page's one shape), then 20px to its right the name in bold at 17–18px with the price right-aligned on the same line, and beneath it a two- or three-line description at 15px in the soft ink, max 38ch. A short note such as an allergen follows the description in the accent ink. No boxes. Holds 6–10 items per category.
sections.mobile: One column. Photographs shrink to 52px and stay at the left; name and price share the first line with the description beneath at 15px. Category names at 8.5vw with the count on the same baseline. A sticky row of category names as text links lets the reader jump.

sections.name: Portrait on its own ground
sections.blueprint: One chapter per screen, three to six chapters. Each is a full-bleed field 100svh tall whose flat colour is taken from its own photograph: the darkest large tone in the picture (a deep brown for a wooden interior, a slate for a winter coast), so picture and page seem to be one surface. In the centre stands one portrait photograph at 3:4, 506×675px (75% of the height), top 112px, square corners, no frame. Type sits in the corners on 32px margins in the light ink: the chapter's title at clamp(28px, 2.4vw, 36px) top-left as its heading; one sentence at 17px, max 32ch, bottom-left; a text link to the chapter's page bottom-right. As each chapter arrives its field starts as a panel inset 20px from the viewport edges and grows to full-bleed, while the portrait scales from 0.92 to 1 (background colour over 600ms, scale over 800ms, both easing out), so the change reads as the room changing, not as a new slide. A chapter may hold a short muted loop or a single enlarged letterform in place of the portrait, on the same kind of field. The first chapter's title doubles as the section heading.
sections.mobile: The portrait becomes 80% of the width at 3:4, centred at 45% of the height. The title sits top-left at 24px, and the sentence and link stack bottom-left at 16px under the portrait. The field still takes the picture's darkest tone.

sections.name: Wall of word tiles
sections.blueprint: A gallery that works with no photographs: a four-column grid of identical square cells with 8px gaps running three or more rows, edge to edge with 8px margins. Each cell is a flat filled tile and centres one large element about 55% of the cell's width: a single word, a letter, a figure with its unit, or a simple inline SVG shape taken from the subject, set at clamp(56px, 9vw, 150px) in the display face. A one- or two-word caption at 14px sits centred 18px above the cell's bottom edge. Tile and ink colours rotate through three or four palette pairs in a fixed order, so a uniform grid looks varied. Where photographs exist, every third or fourth cell is a photograph covering its tile, all given one treatment. There is no hierarchy between cells: it is a specimen sheet. A heading is optional; if used, it occupies the first cell as that cell's word.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 6px gaps; cells stay square and the central element is set at 22vw. Captions stay at 13px. Twelve cells make six rows; if there are more than sixteen, show twelve and let the rest follow after a full-width tile holding a text link.

sections.name: Two columns, highlighted words
sections.blueprint: The story is set as text far larger than anything else on the page: 110–160 words at clamp(22px, 2.1vw, 32px), tight leading 1.18, in the soft ink, flowing through two columns that fill the full width between 24px margins (`columns: 2; column-gap: 32px`, justified, with hyphenation on). No heading. The name at the start is in full ink. Six or seven single words or short phrases carry a flat highlighter background in three or four palette colours, built with an inline `background-color`, `box-decoration-break: clone` and 0.1em of horizontal padding; they mark the facts a scanning reader wants (a place, a year, a client, a skill). The final short sentence is highlighted entire in the strongest colour and is the link to contact. Padding 120px top and bottom. No image and no portrait.
sections.mobile: One column at 20px, left-aligned and unjustified, leading 1.25, with 18px margins. Keep four or five highlights so no line carries two. The final highlighted sentence sits on its own line with 24px above it and works as a full-width tap target.

sections.name: One word is the button
sections.blueprint: The entire band is one link. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, about 60svh tall, contains a single verb of four to eight letters set at 24–30vw in the heaviest weight, tight tracking, sized with `clamp()` so it spans the content width on one line with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The `<a>` wraps the whole band; on hover and focus the field and the word swap colours instantly. In the top-left corner, at 20px, one sentence says what happens next; in the top-right, an arrow drawn as a simple inline SVG, 48px, points up and right. There is no other button anywhere in the section. In a page with a motif, the band's top corners take the motif's shape (a large radius, or a chamfer cut with `clip-path`). Keep the word honest: the action itself, not a slogan.
sections.mobile: The band is 46svh tall. The word is set at whatever size fills the width on one line; choose a shorter verb rather than going below 22vw. Sentence top-left at 17px across two lines, arrow top-right at 32px. The whole band stays tappable.

sections.name: Address in display rows
sections.blueprint: The contact block is a stack of five full-width rows, every one set at the same size, clamp(44px, 6vw, 88px), regular weight, left-aligned with a 20px inset and leading 1.0: the building or venue name, the street, the city with postcode, the opening hours as one compact line, the phone number. Each row is about 150px tall with the text sitting in its lower third; rows are told apart by alternating two flat tones of the section colour as full-width bands, or by 28px of space alone. A sixth row holds a one-word greeting at the same size followed, 24px to its right and centred on the x-height, by a solid round button 0.9em across with an arrow, which opens the email or booking link. Street and phone rows are links (map, call). No heading and no form. Optionally, one small round photograph sits at the right end of the first row.
sections.mobile: Rows at 9.6vw with 16px insets, about 84px tall; the hours break onto two rows (days, then times). The greeting row becomes a full-width band in the accent colour with the round arrow button at its right end, 56px across.

sections.name: The mark, built large
sections.blueprint: On a flat colour field, the brand closes the page as a construction rather than as set type. Across the full content width and about 34svh tall, the wordmark is built from blocks: each letter is knocked out of its own solid rectangle in a palette colour, the rectangles differ in height (60–100% of the band) and butt together with 4px gaps, bottoms on one line. Where the project has a simple geometric mark or motif, enlarge that instead, drawn as inline SVG from flat rectangles, circles and quarter-arcs with the same 4px gaps. Below, 56px lower: four columns of plain links at 15px across columns 1–8, and two addresses or contact lines in columns 9–12. A last row carries the copyright at the left and one small filled button at the right. Space and the block construction do all the separating.
sections.mobile: The block wordmark spans the full width at about 22svh tall; a long name breaks into two rows of blocks. Link columns go two across at 15px, contact lines beneath at full width, then copyright and the small button on one row.

references.name: Ai in Design Report 2026
references.idea: A research report laid out like a colour-blocked print annual: a thermal-blurred video collage on top, an oversized tight grotesk title, and flat orange, lilac, sage and black blocks carrying stats, quotes and chapters.
references.hero: The top 53% is a full-width video band: blurred, heat-map-like abstract footage in orange, lilac and sage, overlaid with four or five hard-edged rectangles of the same footage in grey or green, two tagged with tiny mono labels in white boxes. The header sits flush on top: a black logo block at far left, an orange link tab running to 40% of the width, two plain links at right. Below the band, on white: a two-line deck at about 1.4vw on a 1% left margin, and from 42% across a two-line title at 8.3vw, medium weight, tracking -0.06em. Bottom row: mono credit left, scroll cue and arrow aligned to the title column.
references.type: Beausite Classic, a grotesk with some stroke contrast, in Medium for titles and Regular for text; sentence case, tracking -0.06em at display size. Geist Mono for small uppercase labels. Steps: 8.3vw title, about 5.5vw numerals, about 3vw statements, 16px body, 10px mono. Footer wordmark near 96vw.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #fe7141 #cdabfe #d1ddd3 #f0ff1c — White base with flat blocks of orange, lilac, sage and black assigned to whole modules (stat tiles, quote panels, chapter bands), all drawn from the hero footage. Text is black, or off-white on black.
references.imagery: Hero: abstract blurred video with a heat-map grade, cut into overlapping rectangles. Body: warm documentary photos and clips of people at desks in wood-lined rooms, square-cornered, butted directly against flat colour blocks with no gap.
references.layout: 1% margins and a recurring column line at about 42% where most headings and text begin. Open white text passages ruled by hairlines alternate with tight mosaics in which photos and colour blocks share edges. Each chapter opens with a full-width colour band.

sections.description: A full-width hairline, a tiny mono label at the left, then seven black partner logos evenly spaced across the full width in one row with generous padding above and below, closed by a second hairline. Immediately beneath, another mono label and a three-line statement at about 3vw, flush left and occupying only the left half, followed by a full-width photo strip.

A mosaic with no gutters. A photo of two people at a laptop fills the left two-thirds at roughly 1:1; the right third is split into two stacked flat tiles, lilac above and sage below. Each tile carries a large numeral with a plus sign at about 5.5vw in its top-left corner and a two-line caption directly beneath; the rest of the tile is empty colour.

Quote module as two abutting blocks: a black block on the left 40% holding only a small name and a mono role caption, and a sage block on the right 60% with the quotation at about 3vw, top-left aligned with empty sage beneath. Directly below, a full-width orange band opens a chapter: hairline at top, a large two-digit number with the chapter word under it at left, a two-line title and small paragraph starting at the 42% column.

Black footer. A row of three small source counts along the top, separated by vertical hairlines, then the report name in off-white heavy type at nearly full viewport width with a trademark sign at its top-right, then the year at the same size right-aligned on a second line. Two small link columns with mono headings sit lower left beside the year; a hairline and one row of credits and partner logos close it.

steal: Start most headings and text at a fixed column line about 42% across, leaving the left for small decks, credits and chapter numbers.
Butt flat colour tiles directly against a photograph with no gutter and put one large numeral plus two caption lines in each tile's top-left corner.
Take the page's flat block colours from the hero footage so the abstract video and the layout read as one palette.
references.media: A video collage covers 100% of the screen at load and lifts to the top ~53% to uncover the title on white. Below, a documentary photograph two thirds wide in a sticky frame beside stacked colour stat blocks, a pinned deck of colour cards each with a 10s clip docked bottom-left, and a carousel of equal stills running off the right edge: 12 images and 6 muted videos, all square-cornered.
references.motion: No preloader, but the collage re-cuts itself for about 4s before the title lands. Framer drives the sticky stacking (a 1350px photo frame and three 900px chapter cards that peel away to uncover the next); there is no split text, links change colour over .2s cubic-bezier(.44,0,.56,1), and one panel slides 610px in over 500ms cubic-bezier(0.44,0,0.37,1).

references.name: Anidachi
references.idea: A toy brand built from one custom modular wordmark and one 3D device, both of which change colour with each full-bleed candy-coloured section.
references.hero: A saturated sky-blue field covering the top 92% of the viewport. The custom modular wordmark is repeated in four stacked rows, each spanning the full width inside 30px margins, drawn tone-on-tone in a slightly lighter blue that brightens row by row toward the bottom, so the name works as wallpaper. A tiny white pixel-cat mark sits top-left; a white rounded button with blue text top-right. A 3D flower-shaped toy device hangs on a carabiner from the top edge at centre, barely entered on desktop and fully visible on mobile, where it covers the pattern. A pale ice section starts at the bottom edge.
references.type: AnidachiDisplay is custom modular lettering: monoline rounded strokes on a square grid, unicase forms, used at 7-10vw. Body and UI in Ease, a soft rounded geometric sans, at 20px. Text is always coloured to its section, never black.
references.colour: #24c0fe #eff9fb #b6c814 #ff6b2b #ffffff #000000 — Each section is one flat saturated field (sky blue, ice, chartreuse, orange) with type in a single contrasting tint of the same family or white. The 3D device is recoloured to match its section.
references.imagery: A glossy flower-shaped handheld with cream buttons and a small black screen showing pixel-art animal characters, hung from a metal clasp. Pixel sprites also appear loose on the page and as a giant low-contrast watermark.
references.layout: Full-bleed colour sections of one to two screens with 30px margins. Each holds one giant display phrase at an edge, one small text block, and the 3D device crossing section boundaries. Alignment shifts section to section: centred, left column, bottom-left.

sections.description: Pale ice section. Centred: the small mascot mark and wordmark in sky blue at about 9vw, followed by a two-line statement in the rounded sans at 7vw in the same blue. Below, a left column 370px wide holds a three-line 24px lead and small paragraphs, all blue on ice; a pixel-art cat sprite stands in the right half, and a pill-outlined email field with a round arrow button ends the block.

Chartreuse full-bleed section. A title in the modular display face runs edge to edge in white at about 10vw across the top. The 3D device, recoloured olive to match, hangs from its clasp at left-centre and overlaps a diagonal ribbon of translucent rounded-square tiles, each holding a tinted character, running from lower-left to upper-right and off the edge.

Solid orange section, almost empty. A three-line 14px white paragraph sits near the top, right of centre; the bottom-left holds a two-line hyphenated phrase in the display face at roughly 9vw, white, hugging the left margin and the bottom edge. The lower edge of the device intrudes from the section above.

Ice ground with an enormous pixel-art face in a barely darker green tint as a watermark filling the frame. Lime wordmark lower-left at about 300px wide, three stacked lime links at centre, one link at right, tiny copyright beneath the logo.

steal: Repeat the wordmark as tone-on-tone rows filling the hero, stepping the tint row by row, so the brand name is the background pattern.
Give every section one saturated colour, set all its text in a single contrasting tint, and recolour the 3D product to match.
Anchor a giant two-line display phrase to the bottom-left corner of an otherwise empty colour field, with one small paragraph far away at the top.

references.name: Odyssée
references.idea: A medical-aesthetics clinic presented like a skincare editorial: soft-lit close-ups of skin and slow muted loops carry the page, a thin navy serif voice argues for method over myth, and the page ends on a rolling pearl engraved with the wordmark, one polished object that stands for the result.
references.hero: A full-bleed muted video portrait (a woman resting her chin on her hands in pale grey-blue studio light) fills the screen, followed at once by a second full-bleed close-up of lips and jaw. No headline: a single 42px strip crosses the exact vertical middle in white, the serif wordmark at x=20, an 18px serif tagline about medical aesthetics at column 3 (x≈255), and four tiny tracked caps links on the right ending in the booking link, which all but vanishes against the pale picture. The strip holds while both pictures pass under it, then becomes a sticky 42px header. The entrance is a flat warm grey veil carrying only the wordmark and tagline, lifting over about 2.5s.
references.type: Two families. psTimes, a condensed Times-style serif at weight 350, for statements at 48px (3.3vw) and 32px and for titles and the tagline at 18px, sentence case, leading about 1.0-1.05, every statement with a first-line indent of one column. Basel Grotesk at 430 for 14px body and 12px lightly tracked uppercase labels and links; the house version sets those in sentence case at 16px. Fixed px sizes per breakpoint, no clamp().
references.colour: #fffcf8 #1e305e #ffffff #28292a — A warm cream ground behind nearly everything, one deep navy for 88% of the text, the progress rule and a duotone on secondary pictures, white only over photographs. A single small red dot on a live clock is the only accent; the photographs supply skin tones, pale grey-blue studio grounds and a champagne pearl.
references.imagery: Soft, even studio light on pale grey-blue backgrounds, natural skin with no retouching gloss, tight crops (lips, eye, nostril, knees) and one face turned 90 degrees for tension; slow, nearly still muted loops of skin, serum drops and bubbles used as living photographs; a navy duotone on two link cards. Square corners and cover crops everywhere.
references.layout: 20px outer margins on a 12-column grid (columns about 117px). Text has two anchors: column 3 (x≈255) for statements, body and labels, and the exact centre line for right-half paragraphs and cards. Media is always full-bleed, an exact half (720/720) or flush tiles with no gutter. Cream gaps of 232-552px separate sections, roughly one idea per screen; the closing contacts huddle in the left half.

sections.description: A 48px light serif statement on three lines from column 3 to the right margin with a one-column first-line indent, a small 108x161 double-portrait thumbnail docked at the left margin, then 14px body in a narrow column and a booking link.

Pinned for four steps: a counter, a label and a 1400px rule whose navy fill grows a quarter per step, over four 350x263 muted 5s video tiles flush edge to edge; the active tile at full strength, the other three washed to about 10%, each with an 18px serif title beneath.

Split on the centre line: a tall 672x1233 muted skin close-up holds the right half while scrolling, a small 233x291 clip of a serum drop sits just left of centre with a short caption, and a three-word 48px serif headline arrives at x=20 at mid-height.

Contact rows, an opening-hours table where only today is in full navy, and a live local clock with a pulsing dot; then the page lifts away to reveal a fixed full-bleed 9s loop of a pearl rolling on a pale grey surface with the wordmark engraved round it.

steal: Make video behave like photographs: muted, looping, with posters, 5-29s of nearly still subjects started by script when they come into view, square corners and cover crops everywhere.

Give every serif statement a first-line indent of exactly one grid column and anchor the block at column 3 with 20px outer margins, so the indent reads as a deliberate grid step; use the exact centre line as the second anchor for half-width pictures and right-half paragraphs.

End on real local detail (an hours table that marks today, a live local clock), then reveal a fixed full-bleed brand object as the last screen. The site's tiny white caps nav over pale skin all but disappears; the house version is a plain bar with the booking action as a real button.
references.media: Video is the main medium: a 27s portrait loop and a second close-up fill the first screen, then four 5s tiles flush edge to edge, a 720/720 diptych, a tall half-width clip held while scrolling, a full-bleed band that fades up from cream, two navy duotone cards, and a fixed pearl loop revealed under the footer. Nine images and eight muted, looping videos with posters, started by script; no canvas.
references.motion: No preloader: a warm grey veil lifts off the hero video over about 2.5-3s with the type already in place. Under Lenis the features section pins for four steps, cross-fading tiles over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) as the navy rule grows, images fade over 0.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), underlines grow by background-size over .4s expo-out and the page lifts off a fixed bottom layer to reveal the pearl, but content is opacity-gated, so mid-scroll frames show empty cream, and there is no reduced-motion rule.
